01 How the frames were chosen

Every candidate frame's sharpness (variance of the Laplacian). The capture is cut into equal parts and the sharpest frame of each part is kept, unless it is blurry for its neighbourhood or the camera had not moved.

02 Where the time went

03 People check

scan-studio is for objects only. Frames are checked for faces with OpenCV's Haar detectors; a person in the capture stops the run.

04 Accuracy against the ground truth

Made on this computer with scan-studio 0.1.0. Nothing here was uploaded; this page makes no network requests. three.js (MIT), Instrument Serif and JetBrains Mono (SIL Open Font License 1.1) are embedded.
